evidence_scope: renewed non-production target insurance collision and structure evidence

target_fingerprint_contract.fail_closed_rule: Refuse capture when the actual target database or full target fingerprint differs.

implementation.persistence: Manifest-defined read-only capture; no executable migration/import configuration.

sql_normalization.rule: Trim outer whitespace and collapse every internal whitespace run to one ASCII space without changing tokens, literals or case.

public_result_canonicalization.json: UTF-8; object keys in the declared query projection/result-contract order; stable array order; unescaped Unicode and slashes; no insignificant whitespace.
public_result_canonicalization.result_hash_preimage: phase2e-public-result-v1 + NUL + query/result id + NUL + canonical public result JSON
public_result_canonicalization.small_cell_rule: Publish zero exactly. Replace every nonzero patient/provider/membership/verification population below 10 with SUPPRESSED_LT_10. Installed schema and enum/reference facts are not population cells.
public_result_canonicalization.anti_enumeration_rule: Hashes cover only the suppression-safe public representation; exact suppressed counts, raw identifiers and row tokens are excluded from every published hash.

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT DATABASE() AS database_name, VERSION() AS database_version, @@tx_read_only AS session_read_only, DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS captured_at_utc

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(is_active=1) AS active_count, SUM(is_primary=1) AS primary_count, SUM(insurance_tier_id IS NULL) AS tier_null_count, SUM(start_date IS NULL) AS start_date_null_count, SUM(expiry_date IS NULL) AS expiry_date_null_count, SUM(start_date IS NOT NULL AND expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND expiry_date < start_date) AS reversed_date_count FROM patient_insurances
queries.result_contract: Existing membership and nullable/date populations; small-cell suppression applies.

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT patient_id, insurance_provider_id FROM patient_insurances GROUP BY patient_id, insurance_provider_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1) d) AS duplicate_patient_provider_groups, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT patient_id FROM patient_insurances WHERE is_primary=1 GROUP BY patient_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1) p) AS multiple_primary_patient_groups
queries.result_contract: Patient/provider uniqueness and one-primary diagnostics; zero is publishable.

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT SUM(membership_number IS NULL OR TRIM(membership_number)='') AS blank_count, SUM(membership_number IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(membership_number)<>'') AS nonblank_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(membership_number)) n FROM patient_insurances WHERE membership_number IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(membership_number)<>'' GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(membership_number)) HAVING COUNT(*)>1) g) AS normalized_duplicate_groups, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(membership_number)) n FROM patient_insurances WHERE membership_number IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(membership_number)<>'' GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(membership_number)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id)>1) g) AS cross_patient_duplicate_groups, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(membership_number)) n FROM patient_insurances WHERE membership_number IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(membership_number)<>'' GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(membership_number)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT insurance_provider_id)>1) g) AS cross_provider_duplicate_groups FROM patient_insurances
queries.result_contract: Aggregate collision groups only; no membership value or low-entropy value hash.

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(is_active=1) AS active_count, SUM(is_default=1) AS default_count, SUM(insurance_type_id IS NULL) AS missing_type_fk_count, SUM(code IS NULL OR TRIM(code)='') AS missing_code_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(name)), LOWER(TRIM(type)) FROM insurance_providers GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(name)), LOWER(TRIM(type)) HAVING COUNT(*)>1) d) AS duplicate_name_type_groups FROM insurance_providers
queries.result_contract: Provider population and structural-quality aggregates; names/codes are never emitted.

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(is_active=1) AS active_count FROM insurance_types
queries.result_contract: Insurance type population; safe reference codes are captured separately.

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(is_active=1) AS active_count, SUM(is_default=1) AS default_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT insurance_provider_id FROM insurance_tiers WHERE is_default=1 GROUP BY insurance_provider_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1) d) AS providers_multiple_default_tiers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM insurance_providers p LEFT JOIN insurance_tiers t ON t.insurance_provider_id=p.id AND t.is_default=1 WHERE t.id IS NULL) AS providers_without_default_tier, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_insurances pi JOIN insurance_tiers t ON t.id=pi.insurance_tier_id WHERE t.insurance_provider_id<>pi.insurance_provider_id) AS membership_tier_provider_mismatches FROM insurance_tiers
queries.result_contract: Tier/default/provider-consistency aggregate state; no tier/provider value.

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(verified_by IS NULL) AS missing_actor_count, SUM(verified_at IS NULL) AS missing_time_count FROM insurance_verifications
queries.result_contract: Verification population/actor/time completeness; no actors, dates, statuses or identifiers.

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('patient_insurances','insurance_providers','insurance_tiers','insurance_verifications') AND COLUMN_NAME='deleted_at') AS soft_delete_columns, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND (TABLE_NAME REGEXP '^insurance.*(scheme|plan)' OR TABLE_NAME REGEXP '(scheme|plan).*insurance$')) AS insurance_scheme_plan_tables, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='patient_insurances' AND COLUMN_NAME REGEXP '(scheme|plan|eligibility|verification_status)') AS membership_scheme_plan_eligibility_columns

SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count, SHA2(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT_WS('|',TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION,COLUMN_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE,COALESCE(COLUMN_DEFAULT,'<NULL>'),COLUMN_KEY,EXTRA,COALESCE(GENERATION_EXPRESSION,'')) ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION SEPARATOR '||'),256) AS sha256 FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('patient_insurances','insurance_providers','insurance_types','insurance_tiers','insurance_verifications')
queries.result_contract: Safe relevant-column structural count and fingerprint.

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count, SHA2(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT_WS('|',tc.TABLE_NAME,tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME,tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE,COALESCE(kcu.COLUMN_NAME,''),COALESCE(kcu.REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,''),COALESCE(kcu.REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME,''),COALESCE(rc.UPDATE_RULE,''),COALESCE(rc.DELETE_RULE,'')) ORDER BY tc.TABLE_NAME,tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME,kcu.ORDINAL_POSITION SEPARATOR '||'),256) AS sha256 FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc LEFT JOIN information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE kcu ON kcu.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND kcu.TABLE_NAME=tc.TABLE_NAME AND kcu.CONSTRAINT_NAME=tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME LEFT JOIN information_schema.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS rc ON rc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND rc.TABLE_NAME=tc.TABLE_NAME AND rc.CONSTRAINT_NAME=tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND tc.TABLE_NAME IN ('patient_insurances','insurance_providers','insurance_types','insurance_tiers','insurance_verifications')
queries.result_contract: Safe relevant constraint count and fingerprint.

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count, SHA2(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT_WS('|',TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE,SEQ_IN_INDEX,COLUMN_NAME,INDEX_TYPE,COALESCE(SUB_PART,'')) ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,SEQ_IN_INDEX SEPARATOR '||'),256) AS sha256 FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('patient_insurances','insurance_providers','insurance_types','insurance_tiers','insurance_verifications')
queries.result_contract: Safe relevant index-part count and fingerprint.

queries.normalized_sql: SELECT 'insurance_type_code' AS domain, code AS value FROM insurance_types UNION ALL SELECT 'provider_type_enum_compatible' AS domain, type AS value FROM insurance_providers GROUP BY type UNION ALL SELECT 'member_type_native_enum' AS domain, 'holder' AS value UNION ALL SELECT 'member_type_native_enum' AS domain, 'beneficiary' AS value ORDER BY domain,value
queries.result_contract: Safe installed enum/reference/schema facts; no counts or provider identities.

bundle_identity.canonicalization: For bundle identity only: UTF-8 JSON with recursively lexicographic object keys, stable arrays, unescaped Unicode/slashes and no insignificant whitespace. Individual result hashes use public_result_canonicalization.

content_preimage_contract.shape: JSON object with exactly the keys implementation_sha256, query_sha256, result_sha256, target_fingerprint
content_preimage_contract.query_sha256: object keyed by the final segment of each queries[].query_id, with query_sha256 string values
content_preimage_contract.result_sha256: aggregate-results result_hashes object renamed to result_sha256; keys recursively sorted by the bundle canonicalization
content_preimage_contract.exact_preimage_rule: Recursively sort the containing object and both hash objects by bytewise/string ascending key; encode one-line UTF-8 JSON with unescaped Unicode/slashes, no insignificant whitespace and no trailing newline.

bundle_identity.capture_instance_rule: SHA-256(content_sha256 UTF-8 bytes + one NUL byte + captured_at_utc UTF-8 bytes)
